text:
maya: Heads up — nightly eval (cohort: enterprise-helpdesk) shows a big recall hit after last night's embed refresh + reranker canary. recall@10 dropped from 0.78 -> 0.66, mrr down 0.54 -> 0.41. Not sure if it's embed drift, reranker change, or reindex bug.

maya: Eval snapshot:```
model.embed: text-encoder-v2.3-quant
index: rebuilt 03:12 UTC using quantized vectors
reranker: ranker-service v1.7 canary (rolled 00:07 UTC)
metrics: recall@10: 0.78 -> 0.66
       mrr: 0.54 -> 0.41
       topk_overlap@50: 0.92 -> 0.74
```

ajay: ugh. can you paste the nightly diff plot? is the hit uniform across prompts or concentrated on certain intents? :thinking_face:

maya: paste below — looks concentrated on 'policy & compliance' and 'billing' queries. overall embed cosine shift is small-ish but topk overlap tanked. https://redwood-internal/evals/1832154321 (private link)

kai: infra note: reindex job used the new vector serializer that packs quantized floats. we intentionally switched to int8 packing to save space last week. If downstream reranker expects float features, that could mismatch.

ajay: good call. if reranker v1.7 was trained on float embed features and now gets packed quant vectors, that could change scores. do we have the reranker input schema logs?

maya: log sample from ranker inputs (truncated):
```json
{"query_vec": "<packed_zlib_base64>", "doc_vecs": ["<packed_zlib_base64>..."], "similarity_scores": [0.82, 0.78, 0.75]}
```

ajay: that looks packed. we should decode a few and check numeric ranges. also want to run nearest-neighbor on raw floats vs quantized to compare topk ids. I'll run a 10k sample compare.

liz: product impact: some customers reported degraded retrieval in logs this morning. we should communicate if this is a rollout regression. timeframe?

maya: agreed. triage plan: (1) reproduce topk divergence on sample set, (2) check reranker input decoding, (3) try reindexing with float vectors or rollback reranker canary, (4) test end-to-end on failing prompts.

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary posted for 2026-02-28 04:00 UTC. anomalies flagged: retrieval_recall_drop (score -0.12), topk_overlap_drop (score -0.18). See run 1832154321.

ajay: initial probe results: on 10k sample, topk_overlap@50 between float-index vs quant-index = 0.72 (matches nightly). nearest neighbor distances compressed; some midsize docs re-ranked out. suspect quantization bias on longer context docs.

kai: I can re-run the reindex job with float embedding serialization (no int8 pack) into a staging namespace. will take ~45m. do we want to try that before any reranker rollback?

maya: yes please. if staging float-index restores overlap and metrics, that narrows to packing issue. ajay will also run reranker input compatibility test.

ajay: FYI reranker v1.7 input parser does `np.frombuffer` assuming float32 array. if pack -> bytes are different length, the parser silently reshapes and pads. Not catastrophic but changes features. pushing a small patch to fail fast on shape mismatch: will open PR.

sre-ops: infra/ops: storage and job succeeded; no OOMs. launch timestamps: embed-refresh job 00:58->03:12, index shard rebuild parallelism 12.

liz: Ok roadmap for comms: if we need a customer-facing note, we should say 'investigating retrieval quality regression after model infra update' and promise ETA by EOD.

maya: assignments: ajay -> run float vs quant decode diffs + PR to fail-fast. kai -> reindex to staging float. maya -> rollback reranker canary if staging test fails. liz -> draft comms. I'll update the thread with numbers.

ajay: quick result from initial decode: when decoding packed vectors some values clipped at ~[-0.98,0.98] vs float full range [-1.0,1.0], which can shift distances for docs with many small-magnitude features. attaching tiny histogram (pasted).

maya: if quant clipping is the culprit, we should prioritize reindexing with float first (cheaper rollback). kai starting reindex now.

kai: reindex to staging kicked off at 1832154500, ETA 00:38. will post when done.

eval-bot: staging-run 1832154599 queued after reindex. will run core cohort eval once indexing completes.

ajay: if staging restores recall, we can either revert packing globally or re-run retrainer for reranker with quantized inputs (longer-term).

maya: noted. timeline: hold canary rollback for 1h while staging test runs unless customer escalations come in.

liz: drafting comms now — will share in #product-desk for review.

kai: reindex complete at 1832154720 (staging). launching eval.

eval-bot: staging eval complete. recall@10 (staging-float) = 0.77, mrr=0.53, topk_overlap@50=0.91. Anomaly resolved in staging.

maya: good signal. conclusion: quantized packing introduced numeric distortion that changed nearest-neighbor topks which cascaded into reranker drop. mitigation: rollback pack and reindex to metal, patch reranker to fail on shape mismatch, and plan retrain reranker with quant features as longer-term.

liz: I'll send the comms update: "we identified a regression caused by an embedding serialization change; we are reverting the packing change and reindexing; customers may see improved retrieval within the hour."

ajay: opened PR: fail-fast on input shape + add unit test for packed vs float decode.

maya: closing loop: rollback scheduled 1832154900, full reindex to prod 1832155400. will follow up when done. thanks team :pray:
